The club is the result of a merger between [[Ikast FS]] and [[Herning Fremad]]. Midtjylland competes in the [[Danish Superliga]], which they have won four times, most recently in [[2023–24 Danish Superliga|2024]]. Midtjylland is based in the western part of Jutland. They have had international stars playing for the club, such as [[Mohamed Zidan]] and [[Alexander Sørloth]]. Midtjylland also has the oldest football academy in Scandinavia {{citation needed|date=October 2025}}. The academy has produced multiple Danish national team players, such as [[Simon Kjær]], [[Joachim Andersen (footballer)|Joachim Andersen]], and [[Rasmus Kristensen]]."}}
